bio: Open fires and sumptuous furnishings await as you arrive at the supremely elegant Buckland Manor, a prime example of the classic English country house hotel, set in 10 acres of verdant grounds. Its restaurant is equally characterful, with wood panelling, oil paintings and garden views contributing to the luxury feel. The cooking utilises quality British ingredients that we all know and love, such as delicious Peterhead cod served with consummately seasoned cannellini beans and sea herbs....
